protocol.sampling: Uniform random actions; each trace starts at the specified initial.
protocol.rng: random.Random; SHA256-derived independent (seed, map name, good/bad) streams; first 8 bytes, big endian.
protocol.labels: Full existing verification AP sets; goal has both safe and goal.
protocol.bad_trace_policy: One false successor, same AP set when possible, then replay remaining actions using true T.
protocol.coverage_denominator: All action-labelled triples in R, including unreachable states and self-loops.
protocol.aggregation: Unweighted macro mean over seed-map cases; seeds/budgets/rotations are not independent replicates.
protocol.totalization_policy:
The observed-edge relation is partial.
Self-loop completion is introduced only to obtain a total transition system
compatible with the existing formal evaluation pipeline.

formal_semantics.simulation_real_to_learned: Every real initial has a learned initial in the greatest forward simulation.
formal_semantics.simulation_learned_to_real: Every learned initial has a real initial in the greatest reverse simulation.
formal_semantics.initial_bisimulation: The greatest bisimulation covers both designated initial sets; for singletons, (i_real, i_learned) belongs to it. This is not mutual simulation.
formal_semantics.identity_bisimulation: Shared state space only: forall s in S, (s,s) belongs to the greatest bisimulation, including unreachable states. Otherwise null (not applicable).
formal_semantics.identity_simulation: The same diagonal-membership test on the indicated greatest simulation.
formal_semantics.strict_identity: The diagonal alone is a relation: labels match and edges are included (simulation) or equal (bisimulation), with actions retained only when requested.
formal_semantics.action_insensitive: Ignore action labels and duplicate targets, matching existing CTL/Kripke semantics.
formal_semantics.action_sensitive: Match every challenged transition with an edge carrying the same action.
formal_semantics.global: Global means the identity metric over all shared states, not just initials.
formal_semantics.diagnostics: Top-1 and the fixed six CTL/LTL formulas are additional diagnostics. Finite-suite agreement is not a bisimulation certificate. Missing LTL is null.

protocol.learner_inputs: S, I, A, L and good traces; no true R, no oracle queries, no bad-trace fitting.

runtime.control_cache: Complete and real-reference evaluations computed once per map, reused across seeds and budgets; not repeated measurements.
